rationale: Importer differential lab only: the platform-fonts determinism digest now hashes platform-fonts.json with each run's per-session backend_node_id replaced by a constant, the way the semantic snapshot digest already treats backendNodeId, so Chromium numbering the same nodes differently no longer fails three-run determinism. Faces, glyph counts, line metrics and snapshot-local indices still enter the digest. No importer, capture or renderer code changes. Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
